name: BLAST
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, for each critical hit, make an additional hit roll against a visible enemy fighter within 1" of the target.

name: BLESSED
text: When making an attack action against a `VAMPIRE`, `DAEMON` or `THRALL`, add 1 to the Critical Damage characteristic of this weapon.

name: BRACE
text: When determining how many ranged weapons the bearer is equipped with, two weapons with this special rule count as one.

name: BRUTAL
text: Melee attack actions made with this weapon ignore the Parry weapon rule.

name: CUMBERSOME
text: When the bearer is the target of a melee attack action, subtract 1 from their Fight characteristic.

name: ONE-USE
text: This weapon can only be used for one attack action each battle.

name: PARRY
text: When the bearer is the target of a melee attack action, add 1 to their Fight characteristic.

name: PIERCING 1
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, subtract 1 from the target's Armour characteristic (to a minimum of 0).

name: PIERCING 2
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, subtract 2 from the target's Armour characteristic (to a minimum of 0).

name: PIERCING 3
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, subtract 3 from the target's Armour characteristic (to a minimum of 0).

name: POINT BLANK
text: This ranged weapon may be used for melee attack actions: set the weapon's Range characteristic to 1", and use the bearer's Fight characteristic for the hit rolls.

name: POISONED
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, if any damage is allocated to the target, they are poisoned. When a poisoned fighter is activated, roll a dice. On a 1, the fighter is no longer poisoned. On a 2+, allocate 2 damage points to that fighter.

name: RELOAD
text: This weapon must be reloaded after being used for an attack action. A fighter can reload one of their weapons with this special rule when making the wait action.

name: TWO HANDED
text: When determining how many melee weapons the bearer is equipped with, this weapon counts as two.

name: UNRELIABLE
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, if any hit rolls result in a 1, all hit rolls are discarded and the attack action ends.

name: UNWIELDY
text: This weapon cannot be used as part of a dual wielding attack, either as the main hand or the off-hand weapon.

name: WHIPCRACK
text: When making an attack action with this weapon, unless used as an off-hand weapon, the target cannot make reactions.
